an4.195:4.3: ‘Vappa, take an individual who, due to the fading away of ignorance and the arising of knowledge, is restrained in body, speech, and mind.
an4.195:4.4: Do you see any reason why defilements giving rise to painful feelings would defile that person in the next life’?
an4.195:4.5: When that was said, sir, Vappa of the Sakyans, a disciple of the Jains, said to me:
an4.195:4.7: Take someone who did bad deeds in a past life. But the result of that has not yet ripened.
an4.195:4.8: For this reason defilements giving rise to painful feelings would defile that person in the next life.’
an4.195:5.5: ‘Sir, why is this? What’s the meaning of that’?
